examples.arabic: عذراً يا أستاذ سالم، هل قلتَ للتو إننا سنجري المحادثة في منزلك، بينما اتفقنا على اللقاء هنا في مقهى الأندلس بشارع المتنبي؟
examples.english: Excuse me, Mr. Salem, did you just say that we will conduct the conversation in your home, while we agreed to meet here at Al Andalus Cafe on Al Mutanabbi Street?
examples.transliteration: 'Udhran ya ustaadh Salim, hal qulta lit-tawwi innana sanujree al-muhadathah fee manzilika, baynama ittafaqna 'ala al-liqaa' huna fee maqha Al-Andalus bi-shari' Al-Mutanabbi?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: ابتسمت السيدة وقالت لا تقلقي يا ابنتي بيتك قريب من هنا
examples.english: The lady smiled and said "Don't worry, my daughter, your house is close from here."
examples.transliteration: Ibtasamat as-sayyidatu wa qalat la taqlaqi ya ibnati baytuki qareebun min huna.

examples.english: The child says "Is there water here?"
I see an old man standing here.
